result.title: Rescaling OLS-Merged Adapters To Improve Personalized Image Generation
result.summary: Merging multiple adapters into a single image generation model reduces deployment costs while preserving diverse task capabilities or personalization modes. State-of-the-art methods such as RegMean, Mix-of-Show, and Subspace Routing fit the outputs of the merged model to those of the individual adapters using ordinary least squares (OLS). We show that this reconstruction objective systematically shrinks task-specific signals whenever the activation distributions of different tasks overlap, producing a merged adapter that is too weak for downstream use. We derive a decomposition that quantifies this shrinkage and propose rescaling the merged update to restore signal strength. On multi-subject personalization with up to 30 merged adapters, rescaling substantially improves subject fidelity over unscaled baselines. Our approach also improves results on style transfer, concept erasure, image classification, and LLM-based text classification.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析 OLS 类适配器合并（RegMean、Mix-of-Show、Subspace Routing）在多任务激活分布重叠时系统性削弱任务信号的问题，给出量化该收缩的分解，并提出对合并更新重缩放以恢复信号强度，在多达 30 个适配器的多主体个性化及风格迁移、概念擦除等任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是权重/适配器合并层面的信号收缩分析，与 LVR 的推理期状态无关，但其「分布重叠导致任务信号被稀释并可定量分解」的视角，或可作为核查 latent 表示中视觉信息坍缩与多源状态融合时信号衰减的类比工具。
